scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix e2e install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.audit: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix backend audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix e2e audit --audit-level=high
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run secrets && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run contrast && npm run build
